title: Ridge probe: Euclidean metric in DAQB (k=50,kd=22,δ=0.10,λ=0.605,seed=0)
abstract: Replaces cosine with Euclidean distances in DAQB at the frozen ridge to assess sensitivity of quotas and neighborhood geometry. Accept only if ≥+0.001 gain with no cLISI harm (>0.002) vs 0.7414 reference.
